page.overview:
Who is Berylla Naron?

Berylla Naron is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and part of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters.

Berylla is lean, almost to scrawniness. She has black hair and dark brown eyes.

Berylla is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters, only Joiya Byir was weaker and Amico Nagoyin was her equal.

Berylla is 67 years old. She was born in 933 NE and went to the White Tower in 948 NE. After seven years as a novice and five years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
